summary.name: Grammarly
summary.one_liner: Grammarly is an AI writing assistant that suggests grammar, clarity, tone and style fixes and generates text across apps and websites.
use_cases: fixing typos and grammar in emails and documents
adjusting tone for professional or brand communication
rephrasing text to be more concise
enforcing style guides across an organization
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Grammarly as an AI writing partner that corrects typos, rewrites sentences to be clearer and more concise, and suggests tone adjustments while aiming to keep the user's voice. It can review existing text and give feedback based on different reader reactions. Grammarly says it works on any app or website and can generate text from AI prompts. It also offers an Enterprise tier, described as available through Superhuman Go, with features like confidential mode, granular roles and permissions, and data loss prevention. The page states that user content is not sold, used for advertising, or used to train third-party models.
platforms: any app or website via browser
notable: Free individual plan with 100 AI prompts and tone detection
Enterprise tier with confidential mode and data loss prevention
Says it does not sell user content or let third-party providers train models on it
caveats: Enterprise plan pricing not stated on the page; it is offered through Superhuman Go
Individual free plan includes limited features (100 AI prompts); the page does not list paid individual tier prices
Page is largely marketing claims such as ROI and satisfaction figures that are not independently verified
